rules.applies_when: page is intended for public search discovery
rules.check: Fetch the production URL and confirm intended search crawlers are not blocked by robots.txt, authentication, WAF challenge, or persistent 4xx/5xx responses.
rules.expected: The page is fetchable with a successful response and useful HTML by intended search crawlers.
rules.fix: Remove accidental crawl/network blocks using project and infrastructure-native controls without weakening unrelated security.
rules.validation: Re-fetch robots.txt and representative page responses and verify real status/body; verify crawler identity where supported.

rules.applies_when: a URL must be removed from search results
rules.check: Determine whether the implementation relies only on robots.txt Disallow for de-indexing.
rules.expected: Removal uses an indexability/removal mechanism appropriate to the platform while crawl blocking is used only for crawl control.
rules.fix: Propose meta/X-Robots noindex, authentication, removal, redirect, or status-code strategy as appropriate; do not blindly pair noindex with a crawl block that prevents reading it.
rules.validation: Verify crawler access/indexability directives and resulting HTTP behavior.

rules.applies_when: XML sitemaps exist or should exist
rules.check: Parse sitemap URLs and compare status, canonical, and indexability.
rules.expected: Sitemaps list intended canonical indexable URLs and exclude redirects, errors, private routes, and intentional noindex URLs.
rules.fix: Correct the sitemap generator/source of truth.
rules.validation: Parse generated/live XML and sample every class of URL.

rules.applies_when: sitemap lastmod values are emitted
rules.check: Inspect how lastmod is generated.
rules.expected: lastmod represents a meaningful known update and is not changed on every build without content change.
rules.fix: Use real content modification timestamps or omit lastmod when not reliable.
rules.validation: Rebuild twice without content changes and verify timestamps remain truthful.

rules.applies_when: page is public and duplicate variants can exist
rules.check: Compare canonical tag, final URL, internal links, sitemap entry, locale equivalents, and duplicate variants.
rules.expected: Canonical policy is coherent and points to a valid intended representative URL.
rules.fix: Correct project-native canonical generation; escalate strategic consolidation.
rules.validation: Fetch representative variants and verify canonical/status/internal-link consistency.

rules.applies_when: a proposed change alters canonical targets for a meaningful URL set
rules.check: Count affected URLs and determine whether intent/representative URLs change.
rules.expected: Mass canonical changes are explicitly approved with impact and rollback plan.
rules.fix: Prepare mapping and request approval; do not auto-apply.
rules.validation: After approval, verify sampled and full generated canonical set.

rules.applies_when: a resource is confirmed absent or intentionally removed, not merely empty because of a rendering or data failure
rules.check: Distinguish a genuinely missing/removed resource from a temporary rendering, upstream-data, or application failure before considering status-code changes.
rules.expected: Temporary failures are repaired without de-indexing the URL; genuinely absent resources use truthful 404/410 semantics rather than a 200 error shell.
rules.fix: Repair temporary rendering/data failures. For a confirmed missing or intentionally removed existing public resource, propose the appropriate 404/410 behavior and require explicit approval before changing its status.
rules.validation: After approval and implementation, request the URL directly and verify status, body, and that no temporary application/data failure is being masked.

rules.applies_when: a URL is moved or removed
rules.check: Inspect redirect target relevance and chains.
rules.expected: Permanent redirects point directly to a genuine replacement; unrelated removed URLs are not dumped onto the homepage.
rules.fix: Flatten avoidable chains or restore truthful 404/410 when no replacement exists.
rules.validation: Follow redirect graph and compare destination topic.

rules.applies_when: important public pages use JavaScript rendering
rules.check: Inspect initial server response and rendered DOM for title, canonical, H1, primary text, structured data, and crawlable navigation.
rules.expected: Search-critical content is available through a robust server/static rendering path and is not dependent on fragile client-only execution.
rules.fix: Use framework-native SSR/SSG/ISR/server rendering or equivalent progressive delivery.
rules.validation: Compare raw response HTML with rendered output and test representative crawlers where possible.

rules.applies_when: important pages depend on site navigation for discovery
rules.check: Inspect internal navigation and contextual links for real crawlable href destinations.
rules.expected: Important pages are reachable through valid links and not only client event handlers.
rules.fix: Replace non-crawlable navigation patterns with accessible links while preserving UX.
rules.validation: Crawl the link graph from major entry points.

rules.applies_when: page is indexable HTML
rules.check: Inspect title presence, duplication, boilerplate dominance, and topic fit.
rules.expected: Title is unique enough to identify the page and truthfully describes its primary topic/intent.
rules.fix: Generate a concise descriptive title from approved page intent and visible facts.
rules.validation: Render page head and run duplicate-title inventory.

rules.applies_when: indexable HTML page can benefit from a search snippet summary
rules.check: Inspect missing, duplicate, misleading, or boilerplate descriptions.
rules.expected: Description accurately summarizes page value without keyword stuffing or fixed-length dogma.
rules.fix: Draft from approved intent and visible content.
rules.validation: Inspect rendered head and duplicate report.

rules.applies_when: page is intended for search/AI discovery
rules.check: Determine whether a reader/crawler can identify the primary subject, entity, and purpose from visible content.
rules.expected: Primary topic/entity and user value are explicit without relying only on slogans.
rules.fix: Propose content clarification using approved positioning and real facts.
rules.validation: Re-evaluate intent/entity clarity and compare to page decision packet.

rules.applies_when: content is being optimized for a query
rules.check: Detect mechanical repetition, keyword stuffing, or a request to optimize toward a fixed keyword-density target.
rules.expected: Keywords/entities appear naturally as needed for clarity; no fixed density target or stuffing behavior is enforced.
rules.fix: Remove unnatural repetition after page target approval; optimize for clear coverage and user value rather than mechanical density.
rules.validation: Read content for naturalness, semantic coverage, and absence of manipulative repetition.

rules.applies_when: page is indexable and intended to earn search visibility
rules.check: Compare unique facts, examples, evidence, first-hand material, and differentiation against generic category knowledge and sibling pages.
rules.expected: Page provides useful original or specific information beyond interchangeable marketing copy.
rules.fix: Flag information gaps and request genuine product/business evidence; do not fabricate information gain.
rules.validation: Confirm added facts are sourced and materially distinct.

rules.applies_when: structured data is present or proposed
rules.check: Compare JSON-LD/microdata values with visible page facts.
rules.expected: Structured data describes real visible entities/content and contains no fabricated reviews, ratings, prices, authors, or offers.
rules.fix: Remove unsupported properties or populate only from real project data.
rules.validation: Parse schema and compare sampled fields with visible content/data source.

rules.applies_when: schema is added for a search feature or rich result
rules.check: Verify current platform documentation supports the desired feature and page/entity type.
rules.expected: Implementation distinguishes Schema.org vocabulary validity from search-feature eligibility.
rules.fix: Use semantically appropriate schema; do not promise unsupported rich results.
rules.validation: Run current validator/Rich Results test when applicable.

rules.applies_when: FAQPage markup is proposed
rules.check: Verify page contains genuine visible FAQs and current platform support/benefit.
rules.expected: FAQ markup is used only when semantically truthful; never added universally for AEO/GEO.
rules.fix: Remove fake/boilerplate FAQ markup or retain visible useful FAQs without claiming a ranking boost.
rules.validation: Validate visible Q&A and current structured-data guidance.

rules.applies_when: organization/product/person entities are represented across pages
rules.check: Compare canonical names, visible descriptions, schema, social links, About/Contact pages, and product naming.
rules.expected: Real entities use consistent unambiguous names and relationships.
rules.fix: Normalize only where the canonical identity is clear from project/business evidence.
rules.validation: Cross-page entity audit.

rules.applies_when: page genuinely answers definitional, procedural, comparative, or factual questions
rules.check: Inspect whether answers are easy to identify in normal editorial structure.
rules.expected: Use direct statements, steps, lists, or tables when those are the clearest representation; no arbitrary answer-length formula.
rules.fix: Improve structure after content target approval.
rules.validation: Verify each answer remains complete, accurate, and context-preserving.

rules.applies_when: robots or WAF policy addresses AI-related crawlers
rules.check: Classify each current provider agent as search/citation, training, or user-triggered using current first-party documentation.
rules.expected: Search visibility policy and model-training consent are independent decisions.
rules.fix: Create separate agent rules only after current verification and owner policy are known.
rules.validation: Fetch robots.txt, compare groups, and test intended crawler access.

rules.applies_when: the site wants ChatGPT Search visibility
rules.check: Verify current OpenAI crawler documentation, robots.txt policy, and network/WAF access for the search crawler.
rules.expected: The current OpenAI search crawler is allowed and can fetch representative public pages; training crawler policy remains independent.
rules.fix: Correct accidental search-crawler blocks without changing training policy unless separately approved.
rules.validation: Test robots/WAF/HTTP access using current official identifiers/IP guidance.

rules.applies_when: the site wants Claude search/web visibility
rules.check: Verify current Anthropic crawler roles and robots/network policy.
rules.expected: Current search/retrieval agents required for intended visibility are accessible according to owner policy.
rules.fix: Correct accidental blocks; keep training policy separate.
rules.validation: Re-test representative requests and current robots behavior.

rules.applies_when: the site wants Perplexity discovery/citation
rules.check: Verify current Perplexity robots/crawler documentation and live access.
rules.expected: Current Perplexity search crawler can fetch intended public pages under the site's chosen policy.
rules.fix: Correct accidental robots/WAF blocks using current first-party guidance.
rules.validation: Test crawler-appropriate access and record date.

rules.applies_when: CDN/WAF/bot protection is enabled
rules.check: Compare robots policy with actual HTTP behavior for intended search/AI crawlers.
rules.expected: Legitimate intended crawlers are not challenged or blocked before they can access allowed content.
rules.fix: Use verified-bot or official IP allowlisting where supported; preserve unrelated security controls.
rules.validation: Observe successful non-challenge responses from representative verified crawler requests.

rules.applies_when: llms.txt or similar AI-specific file is explicitly requested or proposed for consideration
rules.check: Verify current platform adoption and expected mechanism.
rules.expected: The file remains optional/experimental and is not implemented without explicit approval unless current first-party platform guidance establishes it as a requirement.
rules.fix: Prepare a proposal describing evidence level, maintenance cost, expected mechanism, and affected URLs. If explicitly approved, generate it only from canonical maintained public content and label expected benefit accurately.
rules.validation: After approval and implementation, validate file syntax/links and confirm no private/stale URLs.

rules.applies_when: site has localized URL variants
rules.check: Validate language tags, hreflang reciprocity, canonical targets, x-default use, and successful localized URLs.
rules.expected: Each intended localized page is independently canonical when appropriate and hreflang links resolve consistently.
rules.fix: Correct locale metadata using project-native i18n routing.
rules.validation: Run reciprocal hreflang/canonical checks across locale sets.

rules.applies_when: page contains images
rules.check: Classify informative vs decorative images and inspect alt text.
rules.expected: Informative images have concise contextual alternatives; decorative images use empty alt as appropriate; no keyword stuffing.
rules.fix: Generate alt from visible image purpose/context only when inferable; otherwise request description.
rules.validation: Inspect rendered attributes and accessibility tree where available.

rules.applies_when: a visible above-the-fold image is the likely LCP element
rules.check: Inspect loading strategy, dimensions, responsive sources, and priority hints.
rules.expected: Likely LCP asset is not unnecessarily lazy-loaded and has stable dimensions/appropriate delivery.
rules.fix: Use framework-native image priority/preload only where justified.
rules.validation: Re-run lab trace and inspect field data when available.

rules.applies_when: performance is scored or reported
rules.check: Determine whether metrics come from CrUX/field data or lab tooling.
rules.expected: Field and lab measurements are labeled separately; current CWV thresholds are verified before enforcement.
rules.fix: Correct reporting and prioritize real-user issues using diagnostics for root cause.
rules.validation: Record source, percentile/device/window when field data exists.

rules.applies_when: numeric keyword or performance metrics are used
rules.check: Inspect every numeric metric for source, market, date, and evidence status.
rules.expected: No fabricated values; missing values remain unavailable and provider estimates remain distinct.
rules.fix: Remove unsupported numbers or attach provenance.
rules.validation: Audit Keyword Master Table fields.

rules.applies_when: title/headings/body/slug/anchors are being changed to target search demand
rules.check: Verify the page decision packet includes intent, target cluster, overlap check, evidence, and explicit approval.
rules.expected: Keyword-targeted mutation occurs only for the approved URL/target decision.
rules.fix: Prepare decision packet and batch it for approval.
rules.validation: Record approved/revise/skip state per URL.

rules.applies_when: a new search-targeted page/article is proposed
rules.check: Compare proposed intent/cluster with existing and planned URLs.
rules.expected: New page has distinct user intent/information value or a deliberate consolidation plan.
rules.fix: Differentiate, consolidate, or skip; do not create near-duplicate content automatically.
rules.validation: Update keyword-to-URL map and overlap notes.

rules.applies_when: many templated or AI-generated pages are proposed or detected
rules.check: Assess whether pages primarily exist to manipulate search/generative visibility and add little unique user value.
rules.expected: Every indexable programmatic page has material distinct value; thin scaled pages are refused or excluded.
rules.fix: Stop generation, consolidate, add genuine data/value, or exclude from Search as appropriate.
rules.validation: Sample templates and quantify unique substantive content/data sources.

rules.applies_when: reviews, ratings, author bios, testimonials, credentials, outcomes, or citations are added
rules.check: Trace each claim to real supplied/public evidence.
rules.expected: All trust signals are genuine and verifiable.
rules.fix: Remove unsupported signals or request human-supplied evidence.
rules.validation: Source audit for every material trust claim.

rules.applies_when: repository changes are claimed complete
rules.check: Determine whether the live production domain was tested after deployment.
rules.expected: Local/repository validation and production validation are reported separately.
rules.fix: Run live verification when deployment is in scope; otherwise mark it blocked/pending.
rules.validation: Attach observed live status/render evidence or explicitly state no production validation.

rules.applies_when: IndexNow is implemented or recommended
rules.check: Verify current protocol applicability and participating engines.
rules.expected: IndexNow is described as change-notification/discovery infrastructure, never a ranking guarantee.
rules.fix: Implement only when useful and supported; host/secure key per current protocol.
rules.validation: Validate key and submission responses/logs.

rules.applies_when: Bing/third-party AI citation data is analyzed
rules.check: Inspect whether citation counts are being presented as ranking/authority scores.
rules.expected: Citation/referral metrics are treated as observed visibility outcomes, not universal ranking signals.
rules.fix: Correct labels and causal claims.
rules.validation: Review report language and source semantics.
